faqs: What is Jasuja Hosiery?
Jasuja Hosiery is a manufacturer and trader of hosiery goods, thermal wear and cotton apparel, established in 1976.
Do you manufacture or only trade?
Both. We manufacture our own brands and also trade in well-known brands.
What products do you offer?
All types of hosiery goods, thermal wear and cotton apparel.
Which brands do you manufacture?
JH Thermals, Real Quilt and OEM production, along with many more.
Which brands do you trade in?
White Rose, Array, Sweet Touch, PaceOne, Tropical Rainwear, Pinklush, Kidley, Melini and many more.
Do you offer OEM manufacturing?
Yes, OEM is part of our manufacturing. Call or message us with your requirements.
How can I contact you?
Call +91 93585 83300 or +91 87919 07779, WhatsApp us, or email info@jasujahosiery.com.
Where are you located?
Our location is on the Contact page, with a Google Maps link.
Do you supply wholesale or bulk orders?
Please call or WhatsApp us with your requirement for wholesale and bulk enquiries.
How do I get prices?
Prices depend on the product and quantity. Contact us and we will share them.
Do you deliver to my city?
Call or WhatsApp us with your city and we will confirm delivery options.
How can I become a dealer?
Contact us by phone, WhatsApp or email to discuss dealing with our brands.
How long has Jasuja Hosiery been in business?
Since 1976, which is nearly five decades.
What sizes do JH Thermals come in?
JH Thermals are available in sizes 36 to 90.
Are JH Thermals for the whole family?
Yes. The range covers men, women and kids.
How should I wash thermals?
Machine wash at 30°C, as shown on the care label.
Can I bleach thermals?
No. Do not bleach thermals, as the care label indicates.
Can I iron thermals?
No. Thermals should not be ironed, per the care label.
What are thermals?
Thermals are close-fitting base layers worn under regular clothes to keep you warm in cold weather.
Can I wear thermals under normal clothes?
Yes. That is what they are designed for, as a snug layer under shirts, sweaters or trousers.
How do I choose the right size?
Measure your chest or waist, compare with the size range, or ask us and we will help you choose.
How should I store thermals?
Wash and dry them fully, fold them and keep them in a dry place.

posts.t: How to Wash Thermals the Right Way
p: Thermals last longer when washed gently. Machine wash at 30°C, as the care label on JH Thermals recommends.
Skip bleach, and do not iron them. Heat and harsh chemicals can damage the fabric and its stretch.
Dry them in shade and fold them once fully dry. Washed this way, your thermals stay soft and snug all winter.
posts.desc: Thermals last longer when washed gently. Machine wash at 30°C, as the care label on JH Thermals recommends.

posts.t: How to Choose the Right Thermal Size
p: A good thermal fits close to the body without feeling tight. Too loose and it will not trap warmth. Too tight and it will feel uncomfortable.
Measure your chest or waist and compare with the size chart. JH Thermals are made in sizes 36 to 90, so there is a fit for every family member.
If you are between sizes, think about how you plan to layer, and ask the seller for advice.
posts.desc: A good thermal fits close to the body without feeling tight. Too loose and it will not trap warmth. Too tight and it will feel uncomfortable.

p: Layering keeps you warm better than one heavy garment. Start with a thermal base layer next to the skin.
Add a middle layer such as a sweater or fleece for insulation. Finish with a jacket or shawl to block the wind.
The advantage is flexibility. You can remove a layer when it warms up during the day.

p: Cotton is soft, breathable and comfortable for everyday wear, which is why it is popular for innerwear and basics.
Synthetic blends can dry faster and stretch more. The best choice depends on climate, activity and how sensitive your skin is.
For daily comfort in most conditions, many people prefer cotton apparel.

posts.t: How to Care for Hosiery and Keep It Lasting
p: Check the care label first, since it tells you the right washing temperature.
Wash similar colours together, use mild detergent and avoid harsh scrubbing.
Dry in shade rather than strong sun, and store folded in a clean, dry place. Small habits like these add months to a garment's life.
